arms: fine_tuned:seed0..2 (base intfloat/multilingual-e5-small, prefix 'query: ', TrainConfig defaults, epochs 2, hard negatives: up to 5 TF-IDF top-50 neighbours of dev entities)

data.source: Companies House Basic Company Data 2026-11-01, Open Government Licence v3.0

follow_up_not_in_this_rule: whether the ch_gb or lei_global model transfers to the other lane
known_ceiling: a name change can keep nothing of the old name (shelf-company names, rebrands); no string method retrieves those
personal_data_note: many company names contain a person's name; the extract is used locally and never committed
question: Does a fine-tuned encoder retrieve UK companies by their previous names better than character TF-IDF?
sampling: salted-hash sample of 4,000 of 533,174 companies with a previous name distinct after folding; current name plus up to 7 previous names

splits.rule: dev if int(sha256(lane + '\0' + entity)[:8], 16) % 2 == 0 else test
splits.unit: entity (Wikidata QID); every name of one item is in one split
